Thanksgiving 9 AM Mass and the Nov 25 confession cancellation recorded. Open: whether Thanksgiving cancels the 8 AM Mass, and whether Monday Adoration starts at 9:00 (website) or 8:30 (POLICY from 'after the 8:00 AM Mass').

slots.rationale: R17 wants a cancellation stated, but a box headed 'Thanksgiving Day Mass Schedule' listing one 9 AM Mass states the day's whole schedule. Leaning per precedent our-mother-of-good-counsel-bryn-mawr s21 ('One Mass') and our-lady-help-of-christians-abington s19 / nativity-bvm-media s22 (9 AM instead of the weekday Mass). Hard because 'cancelled' isn't printed.
slots.question: Thanksgiving, Thu Nov 26: record the weekly 8:00 AM Mass as cancelled, since the 'Thanksgiving Day Mass Schedule' gives only 9 AM?

slots.rationale: R10 would time 'after the 8:00 AM Mass' at 8:30, but the parish's website, whose Mass, confession and rectory times match both issues exactly, prints the clock time 9:00-3:00 PM. A printed clock time beats a worked-out one (POLICY, Times) and a later start claims nothing false, so lean 9:00. No place is printed; the parish has one church and nothing places it elsewhere (R38). Hard because the website isn't the bulletin.
slots.question: Monday Adoration: start at 9:00 AM (website) or 8:30 AM (bulletin 'after the 8:00 AM Mass', POLICY timing); end 3:00 PM?

sources.said: Parish Penance Service Wednesday, December 2 6 PM Many priests will be available to hear confessions.
gpt-6-luna read the same as the leaning option: B1 p5 “Parish Penance Service Wednesday, December 2 6 PM Many priests will be available to hear confessions.”

slots.rationale: R30, leaning per precedent st-aloysius-pottstown s17 (a penance service is a celebration of Penance, recorded at its printed start, no end). 7aa678a5 p5: 'Parish Penance Service Wednesday, December 2 6 PM Many priests will be available to hear confessions', with child care in the Church Quiet Room, so it is in the church. Hard because it starts at the weekly Wednesday confession's time: POLICY Weekly or dated rules 6-7 warn against duplicating a weekly slot, but this is a separate, larger service likely running past 6:45. gpt-6-luna read it as a dated confession.
slots.question: Add the Parish Penance Service, Wed Dec 2, 6:00 PM, as a dated confession, though the weekly Wednesday 6:00-6:45 PM confession falls at the same time?

options.label: Leave out (the weekly slot covers it)
